description: Usage-analytics (Aptabase) and crash-reporting (Sentry) invoke bridges. Split out of `default` and platform-scoped because neither plugin's dependency is present in the iOS Cargo build: `tauri-plugin-aptabase` does not compile for iOS (its sys.rs leaves ENGINE_NAME undefined), and `sentry`/`tauri-plugin-sentry` are deliberately gated off there (issue #587, App Store "Data Not Collected" privacy label) — a capability referencing a permission from a plugin that isn't built fails the build outright. The mobile app ships no telemetry by design.
